welcome: A small controller-beta update makes Patch Notes easier to read and close.

sections.title: Patch Notes controller fixes
items: Patch Notes opened automatically after an update now take controller focus, so you can use Back to close them immediately.
Right-stick scrolling now moves the scrollbar with the text and keeps the remembered reading position in sync.
History navigation now moves selection safely when buttons disappear or become unavailable, and refreshes the controls after changing pages.
